reviews.text: My baby is an 11 year old pitbull with allergies, skin issues and anxiety.  The tech who cut her nails today was wonderful with her and made her feel calm and took really good care of her.  Very pleased!
Everything was great love the haircut
Our fav spot to take our pup Benson , who has some anxious tendencies, but always is happy to see Chantel. She and the rest of the staff take great care of him!!

I absolutely love them! Chantel is incredibly hardworking and has such a huge heart for animals. It means so much to see her support and welcome adoptable pups into the store—and it has been amazing to see multiple dogs find homes! 🐾♥️💕

The store also has a great selection of products and is such a wonderful place for pet lovers. I could spend all day checking out the toys and playing with the amazing dogs they help.

Here’s a picture of my favorite boy, Leopaw, who received so much love and care (and personalized meals 🥰) from Chantel and the DSP staff before finding his home. Special thanks to Stephanie for finding him on the ACCT website. 🐾💗🐾 Highly recommend! 💯
Angel is a phenomenal groomer! Great communication and attention to detail, and our dog always leaves looking happy (and well-groomed). I highly recommend Angel!
Stop by to get a friend treats for their dog! Chantal was amazing. She knew the dog and suggested the treats that the dog loves. They were a hit. Great asset and knowledgeable. Thank you Chantal!

We ❤️ DSP! Chantal (aka the dog mayor of passyunk Ave) is AMAZING and such a pup whisperer. My dogs quite literally pull me in the store just to visit her .. but I always end up finding something else that we need. Selection & Treat Dealers are 10/10!!

Doggie Style on Passyunk Ave is the best! Chantel and Lauren were so helpful when I was finding a new harness for my dog Gizmo, he loved the one they picked! I was also looking for soft treats and Chantel was knowledgeable about which would be best for my senior pups. Also thankful to Renee for giving Gizmo the best nail trim!
I take my dog to Angel and always have a very good experience.   My dog is very anxious and always comes out well.
Zack is just terrific. He grooms my pet beautifully and I always feel confident in my pet's care.
Had a wonderful experience talking to Shantel (sp?) So knowledgeable and kind, I will be back.
Caring, fast, and fit both dog in! Thanks!
Great place

Chantel and all of the staff at Doggie Style are amazing!! I have been experiencing a few issues with my dog and Chantel is so knowledgeable about the various products and it has been incredibly helpful. I will never shop anywhere else (unless Doggoe Style doesn’t have what I need)! I’m so thankful for the Doggie Style team!
Best style my dog has had. I left it in the hands of groomer. She did excellent job. She knew what he needed I left it up to her. She is excellent and would definitely recommend her.
We used the weekend wash special!  Very friendly quick and efficient.  So worth it for a clean city pup.  Unscented soap option is a plus!
Very pleased with my baby girls bathing today.  She was a bit anxious at firsr but did well.  She is so soft and cuddly now too.  ❤️🐶🐶❤️ …
Chantal and team are always so good to my Dolly girl, who is a frequent bone shopper. The staff is always so friendly and always keep Dolly in mind for treat and merchandise recommendations :)
Chantel at the Passyunk location has been so helpful and kind. My dog loves going in to visit her and she was so helpful picking out a new brand of food for my pup! Thanks Chantel!!
Thanks for your help, Chantel!

Doggie Style is my go to for my dogs! Chantel always greets us with a smile and remembers us each time we come in. Their commitment to animal rescue combined with a great selection of items keeps me coming back!

Doggie Style on Passyunk Ave was great!  Well stocked and clean.  All employees were friendly and helpful. Compliments to the groomer Daniel who did an awesome job and very attentive to our dog.  Will be back!
This place has everything you need and everyone is so sweet and helpful! Chantel helped us choose the right salt-safe boots for our puppy, and even let us try them out in the shop. Highly recommend.
Cybill Shepherd & Sheldon Cooper left with a spring in their step! Thank you!
Can’t beat their bath specials! Love this place, great customer service, awesome handlers and quality service.
Wonderful staff and groomers ! I can’t say enough about how great my Chocolate Lab looks . He’s a nervous guy but he loves the groomer ! Thank you!!

Doggie Style Pets on Passyunk has always been our go to place for all our doggie needs. Today in particular two employees went above and beyond for us. It is my little Korra’s birthday and Y’nhia was able to squeeze us in early this morning. When I came back to pick her up, the grooming was perfectly executed. Chantel was working the front desk and had amazing customer service. She helped me pick out the cutest Hanukkah toys and even gave Korra an extra treat. We appreciate this establishment & will continue to come back. 🙂
Dogs in the store! Cashier was really nice and fun to talk to. And the food, of course,was top tier- my cat's real keen on these catnip-flavored greenies
Angel did a fabulous job grooming my Yorkie.
Got the best dog treats and toys. Chantel was genuinely incredible.

If you take your pet here for a grooming or bath please know if your pet is injured they will not take responsibility, I took my door there for a bath several times and the last time I took him when they brought him out.His paw was all bloody , and then they said , oh , we had a little incident the"little incident" was his entire nail being pulled out of his paw. I took immediately to my vet and they treated it and he was put on multiple medications. They refused to reimburse the $186.00 I paid for the Vet bill. I spoke to Madison the store manager and then Howard Nelson the President and Owner. He demanded my vet send him all my pets medical history which amounts to 9 years worth. Howard said it was an accident but it happened in their care so they should be responsible. Please be aware of their Injury policies.
Luna loves getting her nails trimmed by Karen here. Even got a pup cup❤️😁 …

My dog Biggie and I had an awesome experience with Doggie Style. I started with Rachel at Doggie Style South Street and she walked me through setting up a bath visit online. Then made my appointment at the Passyunk location.  That's where Biggie had his first bath! We will be back!
Helpful and knowledgeable staff, great selection of healthy treats, fair prices.

Karen has been grooming my precious Chloe for over a year and she has been the best groomer that I have found. She does excellent work and is very caring! Chloe is very social and Karen let's her say hello to the staff before her service. So cute! Thank you Karen! 😊
UPDATE: September 28, 2025. Karen has since retired and my first experience with a new groomer was that he called out sick and I had been left a voice mail. Well, I'm not sure where the message was left but it wasn't on my phone. My girl was already 3 weeks overdue for her groom. I was not a happy customer and left without rebooking. I realize things happen but initially they didn't call to inform me that Karen was leaving until her last day. I book months in advance. Her appointment should have been rebooked well in advance so that there was no disruption in service. For these reason, I am seeking services elsewhere.
Chantel is always so helpful! She gives me great product recommendations that I now keep buying regularly! She is also so friendly and nice!
Our favorite store 🥰 if you haven’t gotten a hat for your dog, you should!! …

Have had such great experiences with doggie style pets in Passyunk! Angel gave my golden a full groom and did such a great job. She looks very natural and (best of all) no more grinch feet! Not a choppy area in sight and I’m sure it’s not easy controlling her high energy level. My other dog (lab) got a bath by Daniel & he did great too. She came back happy & smelling nice. Can’t believe how affordable it was too! Would definitely recommend
Went to meet Mole today and had the best experience with Chantel! She was so helpful, so knowledgeable and so sweet! Thank you for all of your help, Chantel!

The pet store by my house is closing down And I decided to stop past Doggiestyle pets on east passyunk. They have such a great selection, and Chantel was extremely helpful, and gave great advice and I will be back !

Booked an appointment with them a they had to reschedule last minute a week out, so I took the reschedule. Was supposed to have an appointment today at 10 am and at 9:30 I get a call they rebooked me with the same groomer and they don’t think she’s coming back. Shouldn’t have booked me with the same person and 30 minutes notice is so unprofessional. Will never book again.

Shoutout to Chantey for being so helpful! I just needed a few things for my cat, and she went above and beyond to make sure I got exactly what I needed. Super friendly and knowledgeable—thank you for making it such an easy experience!
Pluto loves it here

Karen is awesome! She always says my boy Blu is a good boy for her. Check out his signature Mohawk. Chantel checked me out and helped me pick out treats perfect for Blu’s sensitive belly. Chantel is a sweetheart!
Great selection of harnesses I got one for my pet who is not a dog
Always very friendly and efficient. Karen is wonderful with my temperamental pups and the front desk crew always gives them lots of ❤️.
Angel is awesome and gentle with my Prince

Absolutely love Doggy Style Pets! Karen is a miracle worker. Our dog Griffin has some behavioral issues that make grooming a real challenge, but Karen handled him with incredible patience and care. Not only did she give him the best haircut he’s ever had, but she was also able to do a full grooming without any issues. She’s helped him in ways we simply couldn’t, and we’re beyond grateful. We could never conceive of having anyone else groom our dog. Highly recommend Karen for any pup, especially the tough or sensitive ones like ours!
Love this place and Karen always does a wonderful job with my fur baby!
Coopers groom Karen is just awesome. Every hair is just perfect and she’s great with him. Grateful we were paired, Cooper is 11 and he’s been going to Doggie Style since he became part of my family
Great experience and my dog seemed to love it too!!!

We love taking our Akita to Karen at Doggie Style in East Passyunk! She always does such a wonderful job with her bath, brush, and nails and she's fast! The app makes it super easy to schedule appointments.
Alyssa is the best!!!!  So fast and does a great job!!
Excellent local pet store with a really friendly, helpful staff. They always have what I need for my dog.

I was in line waiting to check out. The employee (Meg, I think) was on her phone, and had obviously seen me. She continued ignoring me for several minutes. When I finally gave a wave, she sighed and was clearly irritated by having to deal with me. I love the store but this interaction was quite negative.
I have been using the services at Doggie Style (Passyunk) for my dog for 6 years and they are always professional, caring, clean and friendly.  Karen is an AWESOME groomer!
amazing experience - angel did a perfect job w grooming our pug
Our feisty dachshund gets groomed there and they know just how to tame her and leave her feeling great! Thanks, Passyunk grooming crew!
Karen is the best! She dealt with my nutjob goldendoodle for nail clipping and ear cleaning. She did an excellent job.
Karen does a great job of grooming Romeo.  She is quick, pleasant and does a great job.  We are very pleased with her services.
Thank you for taking good care of my nervous pup, Alyssa!
Angel is great with her, it is hard to find someone that she will stay for.
Angel did a wonderful job with my golden retriever today. It was a lot of hard work getting all of her undercoat off. Great job!

Samantha was absolutely amazing. Our dog is a bit timid and does not like to get his nails done so she let us come back to hold him. She did a great job on his nails and was quick about it to make sure he was in and out! Will 100% be returning!
great store, emoloyees, and groomers. Always communicative about my dogs well being/needs during grooming and always have a nice experience with all employees!

This place has always been great for all my dog needs, but I want to compliment the two ladies at the counter around 1:15pm today, a customer was screaming and losing their cool about something out of their control that doggie style tried to fix and this woman wasn’t having it. I spoke up to back up the workers because I admired their composure and professionalism.

Anywho! Can’t recommend this place enough, my dog loves everyone there and always gets lots of love and treats! Love their all natural options and healthy brands of treats, food and baked doggie goodies!
Karen did a phenomenal job grooming my mini doxen! Definitely will be back
Karen did a full groom on our 12 year old poodle and she looks great!
Very nice people and great with my dog

What a great place to take you dogs for grooming. Customer care is incredible, service is outstanding. I’m so happy with my experience at this  location. They go above and beyond to provide excellent grooming services.

Thank you!

We’ve been going to Karen C for a few years now.  She always does a great job grooming my nervous dog.  Karen is pleasant, caring and I know Lacey is in great hands.  Staff is also very nice.  Thanks!
Angel is the absolute best! He’s so good with my high energy pup and always leaves him happy and looking great!
I always take my pups here. They do a great job trimming their nails and everyone is so nice!
